title: Zebra eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='62' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='27' y='72' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='38' y='72' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#dcdce8'/>
  <rect x='50' y='72' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='72' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#dcdce8'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='27' y='85' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='38' y='85' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
  <rect x='50' y='85' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='85' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M30 55 q6 7 0 14' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 54 q6 8 0 15' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 54 q6 8 0 15' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 55 q6 7 0 13' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M62 58 Q72 46 70 34 L82 32 Q82 50 72 62 Z' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- neck stripes -->
  <path d='M66 52 q5 -6 6 -12' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M71 54 q5 -6 6 -12' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='28' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='89' cy='31' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#c8c8dc'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='92' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <!-- mouth open eating -->
  <path d='M88 34 q3 4 6 1' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <circle cx='78.8' cy='23.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M72 20 l-4 -9 q0 -2 2 -1 l6 6 Z' fill='#e8e8f0' stroke='#c8c8dc' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M84 19 l4 -9 q1 -2 -1 -1 l-6 6 Z' fill='#e8e8f0' stroke='#c8c8dc' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- ear inner -->
  <path d='M72 19 l-2 -5 l4 4 Z' fill='#d888c8'/>
  <path d='M84 18 l2 -5 l-4 4 Z' fill='#d888c8'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M64 30 q1 -5 3 -7 q1 4 3 5 q0 -5 2 -7 q1 4 3 5 q0 -4 2 -6' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- ear tuft -->
  <path d='M70 12 q-2 -3 0 -5 q1 2 3 1' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack - apple -->
  <circle cx='94' cy='37' r='5' fill='#e84040'/>
  <circle cx='92.5' cy='35.5' r='1.5' fill='#ff8080'/>
  <path d='M94 32 q1 -2 3 -2' stroke='#60c040' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M21 58 q-6 -2 -8 -8' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='49' r='3' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
</svg>
